title: I dream in the same setting every night, is that considered "the mall"?
content: For about 8 years now I dream of the same place every night. It's a long shore line along the ocean, one end has a motel/apartment dwellings where I have a room. There's usually orcas swimming in the water that I can watch from the balcony (my favorite animal). The shore is several miles long and I've explored quite a bit (shops restaurants, etc ) at the end there is a very large "SeaWorld" type facility and there's a university. I always recognize where I am, and sometimes there's tons of orcas, sometimes there are none. I just stumbled across this group and was wondering if what I'm experiencing is considered the same kinda thing as y'all? Or is this just some safe place dreamscale my brain has created?
